verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents a built-in Gemini AI assistant in Gmail (pricing page) and a Meet 'Take notes for me' feature, which is a concrete task users hand off to the built-in AI. Both are thin, single-line mentions that do not show how broadly tasks can be delegated across apps or how the assistant performs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what tasks Gemini can carry out, coverage across Docs/Sheets/Drive, multi-step task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
